checks.name: GOV-001
checks.summary: The state zip script derives releaseReady directly from the aggregate gate overallStatus only.

checks.name: GOV-002
checks.conditionText: Summary includes explicit fields: aggregateReportPath, aggregateStatus, releaseRunId
checks.expectation: Summary includes explicit fields: aggregateReportPath, aggregateStatus, releaseRunId
checks.summary: The state zip summary schema exposes the aggregate report path, status, and run identifier explicitly.

checks.name: GOV-003
checks.conditionText: Fails closed (throws/returns non-zero) if aggregate report is missing, unparsable, or lacks overallStatus
checks.expectation: Fails closed (throws/returns non-zero) if aggregate report is missing, unparsable, or lacks overallStatus
checks.summary: The state zip script fails closed when the authoritative aggregate report is unavailable or incomplete.

checks.name: GOV-004
checks.conditionText: State zip generation (statezip-npdev-general.ps1 -ReleaseReady) validates agreement before packaging
checks.expectation: State zip generation (statezip-npdev-general.ps1 -ReleaseReady) validates agreement before packaging
checks.summary: The state zip packaging path records aggregate evidence values directly into the release-ready summary.

checks.name: GOV-005
checks.conditionText: At least one automated test proves the summary returns false when gate is failed
checks.expectation: At least one automated test proves the summary returns false when gate is failed
checks.summary: Automated test coverage references the release-ready summary decision path.

hits.line: Assert-True (-not $releaseReadySummary.releaseReady) "release-ready-summary should return releaseReady=false when aggregate gate is failed."
Assert-True ($releaseReadySummary.packagingMode -eq "DIAGNOSTIC") "release-ready-summary should fall back to DIAGNOSTIC packaging when aggregate gate is failed."

checks.name: GOV-006
checks.conditionText: Every child report consumed by the aggregate gate has runId field present and validated
checks.expectation: Every child report consumed by the aggregate gate has runId field present and validated
checks.summary: The aggregate beta gate enforces child report runId presence and tracks runId agreement.

checks.name: GOV-007
checks.conditionText: Aggregate gate rejects any child report where runId ≠ current aggregate runId
checks.expectation: Aggregate gate rejects any child report where runId ≠ current aggregate runId
checks.summary: The aggregate beta gate rejects stale child reports with mismatched runId values.

checks.name: GOV-008
checks.conditionText: Missing runId in child report causes aggregate gate failure (not warning)
checks.expectation: Missing runId in child report causes aggregate gate failure (not warning)
checks.summary: Missing child report runId values drive an aggregate gate failure path.

checks.name: GOV-009
checks.conditionText: Test scenario: stale report with mismatched runId causes aggregate gate to fail
checks.expectation: Test scenario: stale report with mismatched runId causes aggregate gate to fail
checks.summary: A test scenario was found that exercises stale-report runId rejection.

hits.line: Assert-True $staleRunIdRejected "A stale report with a mismatched runId should cause the aggregate gate to fail."

checks.name: GOV-010
checks.conditionText: Every gate script (run-*-gate.ps1) writes structured JSON report to scripts\\reports\\out\\
checks.expectation: Every gate script (run-*-gate.ps1) writes structured JSON report to scripts\\reports\\out\\
checks.summary: Every run-*-gate script in scripts\\quality writes a structured JSON report under scripts\\reports\\out.

checks.name: GOV-011
checks.conditionText: Failed runs include: command output tail (last 100 lines), failing task name, per-sample log path
checks.expectation: Failed runs include: command output tail (last 100 lines), failing task name, per-sample log path
checks.summary: The release evidence scripts include output tail, failing task detection, and per-sample log path fields.

checks.name: GOV-012
checks.conditionText: Evidence bundle (scripts\\reports\\releases\\<runId>\\) contains all child reports + evidence-manifest.json
checks.expectation: Evidence bundle (scripts\\reports\\releases\\<runId>\\) contains all child reports + evidence-manifest.json
checks.summary: The current release evidence bundle contains the aggregate manifest and every step report referenced by the aggregate gate.

checks.name: GOV-013
checks.conditionText: evidence-manifest.json lists every copied file with SHA256 hash
checks.expectation: evidence-manifest.json lists every copied file with SHA256 hash
checks.summary: The current evidence manifest enumerates copied files with SHA256 hashes.

checks.name: GOV-014
checks.conditionText: Automated test validates bundle completeness after a simulated failure
checks.expectation: Automated test validates bundle completeness after a simulated failure
checks.summary: Automated test evidence was found for evidence bundle completeness after failure.

hits.line: Assert-True (@($missing).Count -eq 0) "A simulated failure evidence-manifest should still contain every child report."
